text_block_list.text:
The other day, Голд Сити's manager and
I got
together to coordinate her
schedule. However...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Lately, Голд Сити has been busy every
second of
the day. I imagine it's
physically taxing.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry, Trainer! I overslept! It's already
past my
reserved time on the machine,
but maybe we can
still get a spot?
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
Well... so much for that idea. There are
no time
slots left.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry. Here I am, making you waste
your time
too.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити
choice_data_list:
You're probably just exhausted from all the
recent work.

text_block_list.text:
Yeah, but I'm losing out. It's me who
decided I
could do all this—running and
modeling.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text: Literally, how can I not even take proper care of myself? I have to get over this fatigue!
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити
choice_data_list:
Don't be so hard on yourself. You'll just wind up
more exhausted.

text_block_list.name: Голд Сити
choice_data_list:
Besides, after that extra rest, you'll be able to
work harder в тренировке!

text_block_list.text:
You're right. I'll only be wasting time if I
spend it
feeling sorry for myself.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
Okay. I'm back on my feet. What have
you got for
me today, Тренер?
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
Shortly after, we manage to find an open
training
facility to use.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
